currentRepair.cause: Testing-library user.hover produces zero-delta moves. A trusted Playwright WebKit probe also reported movementX=0/movementY=0 at the new option target; neither exercises a nonstationary move required by the canonical guard.

The Root event-details test retains original event identity with nonzero delta; two keepHighlight tests await the source highlight checkpoint before leave/blur. Native-hover experiments and logging removed.

Protected filter51 tests and real10000-item Chromium/WebKit10/10 flows clean. Other incomplete source scopes remain explicit.

review: Manual body-by-body comparison of all three upstream runtime files with all eleven current family test files. Matched means authored observable coverage, not a passing runtime result. Runtime suites deliberately not run.
schema: Each case resolves sourceFile through files[source], target file/title through targets[target]. orderedContract records interactions and assertions in execution order. parameters are expanded individually, never inferred from a title. Defaults apply unless overridden: disposition=matched, lane=jsdom+browser, sourceCondition=none. finalReview overrides the initial comparison's disposition/target/adaptation/evidence by source:line (and parameters where supplied); initial partial findings remain as an audit trail of why additions were justified. All counts describe final resolved records.
